method.memory: JS heap delta + ArrayBuffer delta + whole WASM linear memory once; stable collection outside CPU window
method.limitations: Shared macOS host; point medians, not significance claims. Process/steady CPU informational except the steady CPU gate threshold. MEXC has a small main-thread gain and a fixed larger crossover cohort because preceding samples were unstable.

crossover.protocol: 10 valid crossover pairs, AB/BA alternating by valid pair, maximum15 attempts; reject entire pair only existing memory-baseline quality failures; all attempts retained; no CPU-directed stopping

invalidMemoryBaseline.reason: One before heap delta -193400; whole pair discarded under existing gate rule

validThreeRunRegression.reason: Valid observation retained; fixed crossover follows unstable timing diagnostics

jsonValidationDifferential.interpretation: Difference of independent probe medians; rough syntax-validation cost only, not an exact decomposition of venue parsing.

instrumentationFloor.interpretation: Repeated empty JS calls through the identical proxy and clocks. Count-scaled observer-cost estimates only; no exact subtraction from gross engine CPU. Total wrapped CPU includes both clock reads, proxy dispatch, counters and loop; gross clocked CPU includes only the timed interval.

single.interpretation: Gross per-method CPU includes timing-clock overhead. wsMessage/wsMessages includes crossing, typed venue parsing/state and returned-action serialization. takeFrame includes binary frame writing and wasm-bindgen return copy. Count-scaled empty-wrapper costs estimate observer overhead without exact subtraction. JSON validation is a syntax floor, not typed venue parsing. Prepared batch probes exclude host packing. Instrumented timings are diagnostics, not gate CPU metrics.
